features.name: Bite
features.description: You can use your bite to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with them, the strike deals 1d6 + your Strength modifier piercing damage, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

features.name: Rampage
features.description: When you reduce a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on your turn, use a bonus action to move up to half speed and make a bite attack.

features.name: Blood Scent
features.description: You have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) and Wisdom (Survival) checks made to find or track a creature that is missing any of its hit points.

features.name: Keen Senses
features.description: You have proficiency in the Perception skill.
